user_rule: First two reserved UUIDs in the existing pre-exposure split; keep the entire users isolated from development.
history_scope: Complete original histories, chronological arrival; no prefix cap.
question_rule: After method/config freeze, for each user use the last QA-bearing session at or before one third, two thirds, and the full history. Choose the first two non-boundary questions by existing type metadata, boundary only if fewer than two exist. Retain all original questions/answers; selected QA never enters Writer input.
arms: Strong source S0 and one final selected candidate; exact configs pending development conclusions.
settings_rule: One frozen implementation and same main Reader/model/context/output/call allowance in both arms; report all formation/index/read/score costs.
label_policy: First official labels only; invalid, known missing and not run separate. No tuning, best-of repetition, or label replacement from holdout outcomes.
scope_of_claim: Two independent user histories, exploratory confirmation; QA count is not independent user count.
